record.question: Which exact Cinder Cone vector branches represent the recommended summit circulation, rim paths, and separate crater descent?
record.reason: The official dataset preserves 22 additional Cinder Cone Trail features beyond the selected trailhead-to-summit approach. They form nested and parallel rim, crater, and other-side branches, but neither the feature attributes nor the NPS prose uniquely assigns every atomic feature to a visitor role. Wayproof preserves the complete approach and does not guess the remaining circuit.
